entities.title: Error messages start with `zazzl` instead of `zazzle: `
entities.summary: die and die_errno write the 8-byte prefix `zazzle: ` with a length of 5, a length left from the old 5-byte `afo: `, so every invoker error reads like `zazzldaemon did not start`.
entities.expected: `zazzle: daemon did not start` (the prefix written in full, then the message).
entities.observed: `sys_write(2, "zazzle: ", 5)` writes `zazzl`, and the message follows with no separator: `zazzldaemon did not start`. The unit and smoke tests only look for the message text, so they pass.
reproduction: Standard error reads `zazzldaemon did not start`.

origin.by: Coding agent reconciling the invoker's .dev files with the code after the rename
origin.reference: macos/c/zazzle/src/zazzle_core.h (die, die_errno), against the rename in commit 4c01533
